Week of 23 Aug 2026

Breaking

OpenAI passes one billion users as its IPO paperwork goes public

The company confidentially filed its Form S-1 with the SEC on 8 June 2026; the public prospectus is expected on EDGAR in mid-to-late August, roughly fifteen days ahead of any roadshow. It will disclose audited financials, the Microsoft revenue-share agreement and detailed risk factors for the first time. A September or Q4 listing remains the target.
